name: Hangzhou Turbine Power Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Turbine Power Group Co., Ltd. engages in the power information system integration business in China. The company provides power transmission network communication solutions, including power grid communication solutions, synchronization network solutions, and high-definition video conferencing solutions; and software development solutions, such as data-related solutions, professional application solutions, and value-added service solutions. It also offers technical and consulting services, such as information technology planning, design, business management, consulting, and operation and maintenance services.
